name: supervisor-agents
description: A supervisor-only operating mode that plans work, delegates independent tasks to multiple agents, consolidates reports, and verifies results with the best available local tools.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, delegate, consolidate, and verify with multiple agents.
interface.longDescription: When invoked at the top of a Codex chat, this plugin makes Codex act as a supervising orchestrator: it decomposes work, delegates independent tasks to parallel agents, gathers reports, resolves conflicts, and verifies the final result using appropriate local tools and tests.
interface.defaultPrompt: Act as the supervisor: plan the work, delegate independent tasks to multiple agents, collect and synthesize their reports, and verify the result with the best available tools before responding.
